ETH.note: Names INSA as overseeing implementation of the standards but states no creation, incident, designation or figures.
Mentions sovereignty only in general; no state data rule, hosting or contract terms.
Mentions securing e-government services only in general; no service stated online.
Says only 'aligned with international best practices'; no named international standard or membership.

facts.fact: The Ethiopian Standards Board officially approved 5 mandatory cybersecurity standards and 31 guidelines and frameworks, drafted by INSA with the Ethiopian Standards Institute, according to INSA.
